decisions.reason: Guidance for performing the KDP upload on the client’s laptop does not change the cover design, format, dimensions, or review requirements.
The source changes the upload workflow but does not change the required back matter or author copy.
Using the client’s laptop for guided KDP uploading does not alter the paperback interior layout or trim size.
The upload-guidance workflow does not change the manuscript’s editing requirements or approved passages.
The source does not change chapter illustration selection, placement, sizing, or rendering-quality requirements.
The KDP upload workflow has no necessary effect on the prohibition against the literal newline artifact in the title.
The source does not modify the copyright page’s publisher line, content, or layout.
Guided uploading on the client’s laptop does not change the Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization rules.
The upload-workflow decision neither resolves nor changes the existing uncertainty about the interior title page layout.
